title: Unisex Cat – Knocked It Off. Felt Nothing. Hoodie

seo.title: Cat Hoodie – Knocked It Off. Felt Nothing.
seo.description: A funny cat hoodie for cat people: KNOCKED IT OFF. FELT NOTHING. A smug tabby and a falling mug. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

KNOCKED IT OFF. FELT NOTHING. is the cat hoodie for cat people whose mug did not survive the morning, worn on the couch, on the work-from-home call and to every kitchen counter the cat owns.

KNOCKED IT OFF. runs across the top in tall serif capitals and FELT NOTHING. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a smug orange tabby sits on a wooden side table with one paw still stretched out and its eyes half-closed while a flowered ceramic mug tumbles off the edge and the coffee splashes out below.

Navy carries cream and marmalade-orange lettering with a cream edge around the scene; Sand gets dark brown and deep rust lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this hoodie warm enough for a lazy morning?
Yes. The Knocked It Off. Felt Nothing. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for the couch, the home-office desk and chilly mornings with a cat on your lap.

How does the Knocked It Off. Felt Nothing. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk at all.

Is this a good gift for a cat person?
It is a natural one. Every cat owner has watched something fall off a counter on purpose, so it lands with friends whose mug did not survive and anyone ruled by a cat. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the tabby sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Knocked It Off. Felt Nothing. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
